name: Terrain Raymarching
definition: Rendering terrain using a heightmap (texture or procedural) via raymarching, where the surface is defined by the heightmap value at the ray's xz position.
summary: Terrain Raymarching renders 3D landscapes from 2D heightmaps by stepping rays until they hit the surface, differing from standard raymarching by evaluating a height function directly rather than a global distance field.
